name: Snobs Coffee Roastery
description_short: Artisan coffee roastery on Main Street serving expertly crafted brews and light meals in a relaxed setting.
description_long:
Snobs Coffee Roastery brings the art of coffee to Knysna's Main Street, where the aroma of freshly roasted beans greets you at the door. This isn't your typical chain café — it's a proper roastery where they take their craft seriously, from bean selection to the final pour. The space has that comfortable, unpretentious vibe where locals settle in with their laptops and visitors discover what good South African coffee tastes like.

The menu keeps things simple with light meals and pastries that complement rather than compete with the star attraction: expertly prepared coffee in all its forms. Whether you're after a classic flat white, a pour-over that showcases a single origin, or just a reliable Americano, the baristas know their stuff. You can also pick up beans to take home, freshly roasted on-site. It's the kind of place that becomes part of your Knysna routine, whether you're popping in for a quick takeaway or settling in for a proper coffee break on Main Street.
